params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

# README review: ShaneDeconinck/cides (HEAD 5648798, 2026-09-11)

## Stale claims corrected

- README:3 links to `https://www.cides.be`. The repo says the canonical domain is `cides.be` without www: `CLAUDE.md` ("Canonical domain is `cides.be` (no www)"), `web/astro.config.mjs:6` (`SITE_URL` default `https://cides.be`), `web/public/robots.txt:4`, `web/public/llms.txt:6`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://cides.be`). Live check confirms `www.cides.be` 301s to `cides.be`. Link changed to `https://cides.be`.
- README:8 "Astro 5 static site". `web/package.json:20` has `"astro": "^7.2.8"`, `package-lock.json` locks `node_modules/astro` at 7.3.2 (PR #14). Changed to Astro 7.
- README:9 "Sanity v3 Studio". `studio/package.json:15` has `"sanity": "^6"`, lockfile `studio/node_modules/sanity` 6.10.1. Changed to Sanity v6, with the auto-update note from `studio/sanity.cli.ts:14` (`autoUpdates: true`) and `CLAUDE.md` (Dependencies).
- README:10 and README:55 describe `scripts/` as only the Wix → Sanity migration. `scripts/package.json:7-20` has 14 scripts (publish, seed, seed:about, seed:services, seed:clients, order:services, remigrate:images, clean:services, reslug, fix:image-types, scan:text, fix:text, set:client-urls); root `package.json:15-27` proxies eleven of them. Description widened, commands table extended.
- README:28-31 lists four `.env` values. `.env.example` also names `PUBLIC_SANITY_API_VERSION` and `PUBLIC_SITE_URL`; `CLAUDE.md` (Environment) says the site throws without `PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID` (`web/src/lib/sanity.ts`). Both added, with the throw noted.
- README:64-65 says to set `PUBLIC_*` vars and to "wire" a Build Hook. `netlify.toml:4-5` names the three vars (`PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID`, `PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET`, `PUBLIC_SITE_URL`); `netlify.toml:8-11` gives the exact build command with the sitemap guard, `NODE_VERSION = "24"`, and says Netlify is git-connected. `CLAUDE.md` (Deployment) says the hook is already wired to a GROQ-filtered webhook that fires on published documents only. Rewritten as the current state, not an instruction.

## Missing essentials added

- How to test: `npm test --workspace web` (root `web/package.json:12` `"test": "vitest run"`, `web/test/{i18n,image,localize}.test.ts`, scope from `CLAUDE.md` Tests). The README had no test command.
- Typecheck: `npx astro check` in `web/` (`web/package.json:11`, `CLAUDE.md` Commands).
- `build` side effects: `prebuild` runs `web/scripts/gen-redirects.mjs` (writes `_redirects` from `legacySlugs`, lines 1-4 and 27-38), `postbuild` runs `web/scripts/gen-csp.mjs` (writes the CSP into `_headers`, header comment). `web/package.json:8,14`.
- Studio deploy carries the schema, `main` does not: `studio/sanity.cli.ts:14-16` and `CLAUDE.md` ("Auto-updates never carry our schema").
- Migration flags `--publish` and `--only=`: `scripts/migrate-wix.mjs:24-27,44-46`.
- New "CI" section: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (on `pull_request` and `push` to `main`; steps `npm ci`, `npm test --workspace web`, `npx astro check`, `npm run build`, `test -s web/dist/sitemap-index.xml`; env carries the public project id only, no token).
- Elixir workflows: `.github/workflows/elixir-fix.yml` (`workflow_dispatch` with `plan`, `evidence`, `capability`; `uses: abovebeyond-ai/elixir-fix/.github/workflows/fix.yml@v1`; install/test/build commands as written) and `.github/workflows/evidence.yml` (`if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'elixir/')`, `uses: abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action@v1`, `mode: pull`).
- `elixir.json` declares the production environment (`elixir.json:1-5`).
- Canonical-domain paragraph in Deploy (`CLAUDE.md` SEO, `astro.config.mjs:6`).

## Still true, left as is

- Node ≥ 20, `.nvmrc` 24: `package.json:8` `"node": ">=20"`, `.nvmrc`, `netlify.toml:14`.
- Tailwind v4: `web/package.json` `"tailwindcss": "^4"`, locked 4.3.3.
- Ports 3333 and 4321, `nvm use`, `npm install`, `cp .env.example .env`.
- Languages section: `web/src/i18n/config.ts:5-8`, `studio/schemaTypes/languages.ts:12-16`, `web/astro.config.mjs` i18n block (`prefixDefaultLocale: false`).
- `SANITY_WRITE_TOKEN` for the migration: `.env.example`, `scripts/migrate-wix.mjs:80`.
- Netlify publishes `web/dist`: `netlify.toml:11`.

## Not in this repo (so not added)

- No `/up`, `/.well-known/build.json` or `/api/elixir`: the site is fully static (`output: 'static'`), and `grep` over `web/` finds none of them. Elixir has only `elixir.json` and the two workflows here.

## Surprises (not README changes)

- `elixir.json` declares production as `https://www.cides.be`, but the repo's canonical domain is `cides.be` and www 301s to it (checked live). Elixir measures the redirecting host. Worth a look; changing `elixir.json` is outside this README review.
- `.env.example:2` says "or run `npm run studio:init`", but no such script exists in any `package.json`. `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md` say `cd studio && npx sanity init`, which is right.
- `CLAUDE.md` carries the same stale "Astro 5" and "Sanity v3" lines as the README (What this is), and its Dependencies section lists `js-yaml` among the unfixable audit findings while the lockfile now has `js-yaml` 4.3.2 and `svgo` 4.1.0 after PR #14. Not touched here (brief covers README only).
- The Studio autoUpdates, so the "Sanity v6" figure describes the manifest and local dev, not necessarily what editors see; the README.new says so in one line.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
